description: This Java source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application. It manages user interactions related to account selection, listens for account updates via AccountManager, displays welcome alerts, and handles activity results.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android activity managing account selection and updates, displaying information via UI components, and handling activity lifecycle.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI, registers account update listener, and displays a welcome dialog.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Removes account update listener when the activity is destroyed.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result from account chooser intent, displaying selected account type or cancellation message.
